smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: MNKI
shortDescription: Turns a floor plan image into a furnished 3D view or a render. Basic is $28.99 a month.
longDescription: MNKI takes a PNG, JPEG, or WebP of a 2D floor plan and returns a furnished 3D plan view or a perspective render. A standard render costs 4 credits. Basic is $28.99 a month for 500 credits. Pro is $148.99 a month for 3,000 credits. New accounts start with 40 trial credits and no watermark. A top-up is $10 for 150 credits.
pricingNotes: Basic is $28.99 per month for 500 credits. Pro is $148.99 per month for 3,000 credits. A top-up is $10 for 150 credits. New accounts start with 40 trial credits.
freeTierNotes: 40 trial credits on signup. No watermark.
bestFor: A clean floor plan image that should become a furnished 3D view
A plan you want rendered in more than one material style
notIdealFor: A measured drawing a builder stamps
Virtual staging of a listing photo with no plan
strength: MNKI turns a floor plan image into a furnished 3D view or a perspective render.
weakness: Basic is $28.99 per month, and a standard render spends 4 of the monthly credits.
